def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    rects=[]
    for r1 in range(h-2):
        for r2 in range(r1+2,h):
            for c1 in range(w-2):
                for c2 in range(c1+2,w):
                    color=g[r1][c1]
                    if g[r1][c1:c2+1] != [color]*(c2-c1+1) or g[r2][c1:c2+1] != [color]*(c2-c1+1):
                        continue
                    if any(g[r][c1]!=color or g[r][c2]!=color for r in range(r1,r2+1)):
                        continue
                    inside=[g[r][c] for r in range(r1+1,r2) for c in range(c1+1,c2)]
                    if not inside or any(v!=inside[0] for v in inside) or inside[0]==color:
                        continue
                    # Interior colors encode by the parity of the enclosing frame size.
                    fill=7 if ((r2-r1+1)%2) else 2
                    rects.append((r1,r2,c1,c2,fill))
    for r1,r2,c1,c2,fill in rects:
        for r in range(r1+1,r2):
            for c in range(c1+1,c2):
                g[r][c]=fill
    return g
